summary.root_cause_text: payment_provider_url was changed by ops to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration) and the provider is unreachable, so the worker marks orders processed without recording payments.
recommended: Revert payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v1, or fix connectivity to payments-v2 (the operator rejected my revert).
Then run reprocess_orders for all_unpaid and check_invariants.
Don't restart the worker or reprocess until the provider works.
